run_break_on_failure_tests: run the googletest break-on-failure unit test suite to verify seg-fault behavior on assertion failures
test_break_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1 and verifying seg-fault behavior
test_break_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_break_on_failure command line flag and verify it enables or disables seg-fault on failure
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable value
run_subprocess_and_check_signal: run a subprocess command using gtest_test_utils.Subprocess and check if it was terminated by a signal
